newsitem.title: CHINA: China invests more in raw materials, energy assets.
newsitem.headline: China invests more in raw materials, energy assets.

text.p: Investment in the fixed assets of China's raw material industries and energy sector soared in the first 11 months of 1996, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.

Investors poured 53.10 billion yuan ($6.40 billion) into chemical industry fixed assets between January and November, up 29.8 percent compared with the same period of 1995, the official agency quoted the State Statistical Bureau figures as showing.

Investment in metallurgy sector fixed assets hit 41.44 billion yuan in the first 11 months, up 7.4 percent year-on-year, while the non-ferrous metals sector attracted 11.39 billion yuan, up 14.3 percent, it said.
Forestry fixed assets absorbed 598 million yuan, an increase of 98 percent compared with the same period of 1995, it said.
Investment in coal-mining fixed assets was 19.24 billion yuan in the first 11 months, up 14.4 percent year-on-year, while the oil industry absorbed 63.64 billion yuan, up 3.2 percent.
Investors put 128.38 billion yuan into power generation fixed assets, up 28.6 percent, Xinhua said but gave no details.
